lines.trans: Marina! Arkady Borisovich fell down the stairs!
Hello! We urgently need an ambulance!
What happened?
Well, he went up to clean cobwebs. And here, he fell!
He wanted to invite you to tea. But he says it's untidy at his place.
Why are you telling her? That was a secret!
Get out of here! You almost cut off my ear already!
Don't! They said not to touch and not to move at all!
Are you in pain?
I can't see anything! Where are my glasses?
There are the glasses lying there.
You will come with me to the hospital, won't you? Please!
Well, I don't know.
You can even take him with you. This one here!
The main thing is that you are nearby, as a friend. Please, it hurts a lot!
